items.q: How do you scope a project?
items.a: Every engagement begins with a paid discovery — usually one to two weeks — that ends in a fixed-fee proposal. Nothing binding until you see the shape of the work, the team, and the schedule.

items.q: What is the minimum engagement size?
items.a: Most engagements start above $80,000 for fixed-fee projects, or $30,000 per month for retainers. Below that, our operating model does not earn its cost — and we will introduce you to teams we trust who work at that size.

items.q: Do you take equity in lieu of fees?
items.a: Rarely, and only alongside cash. When we do, it is because we already know your team and believe in your position — not because you cannot afford our rate card.

items.q: Who will actually do the work?
items.a: The people you meet in the pitch are the people who ship. We do not run a sales team that hands off to a delivery team. Our senior operators lead engagements — including the difficult conversations.

items.q: How large is the team we will work with?
items.a: Between three and eight people, depending on the shape of the engagement. Small enough to move; large enough to survive a bus factor.

items.q: Do you work with in-house teams?
items.a: Regularly. About 60% of engagements involve embedding alongside your engineers, designers, or marketers. We are quiet about handovers because the team we leave behind should not need us.

items.q: What time zone do you work in?
items.a: We overlap four hours a day with any client time zone by design. Bengaluru, Dubai, London. Most engagements have a lead in the client's working hours.
One business day for new inquiries, four hours for active engagements. P0 incidents get a five-minute page and human within thirty.
NDA is signed before the discovery call if you prefer. We name clients on this website only with their written permission — many of our best engagements will never appear here.
